_doc: Operations clocks and the ONE deploy they run code from (OPS_CLOCKS_DEPLOY_ONE_PINNED_COPY; design/RimMandrake/operations_metronome_strategy_2026-11-02.md §8 step 0). Checked by src/RimMandrake/Utils/ops_clocks.py check. The deploy is the dispatch clone: nobody edits code there, it only fast-forwards to origin/main, and the ledger-writing clocks (dispatcher, restart, deadman) find their repo from their own file path, so their code and their data clone must be the same tree. Every rm-*, testq-*, timer-guard and account-plan unit systemd has loaded is a clock here, an old timer a metronome phase owns (metronome_phases.json `owns`: rm-ops-watch and rm-restart-reconcile; their units were deleted 2026-11-23 and the names stay, because about 190 live promises are judged through them), or named in outside with its reason; an unclassified one fails the check. rm-dispatcher is a service with no timer (the dispatch phase owns the clock): seat_restart.py and rm-restart-now still start rm-dispatcher.service, so where its code runs from is still judged. Every unit text is a file in this folder, the one home, installed only by `ops_clocks.py install` (design/specs/2026-11-22-units-one-folder/boundary.md). A clock's trigger must exist; whether it is enabled is not judged here (account-plan.timer was off on the owner's order 2026-10-29, removed here 2026-11-04 by TIMERS_PRUNE_AUDIT_FINALLY_READ, and running again since 2026-11-06 06:52Z; its 2026-11-05 week-plan drop-in was removed 2026-11-20, and `check` flags any RM_SWITCH_PLAN in a clock's unit, so the plan reads the standard switching_plan.json where his rulings land; timers_guard watches enabled timers).

outside.rm-relentless: the Relentless tick: retired by the owner 2026-11-13, unit masked (design/RimMandrake/retired_loops_2026-11-13.md)
outside.rm-relentless-*: Relentless worker, check and stage runs: retired with the tick 2026-11-13
outside.rm-account-handover-*: a one-shot account change-over of the handover tool, which was deleted on 2026-11-24 (./acct switch <account> is the door now). No program arms one; the name stays known so that a leftover unit is named, not unknown
outside.testq-*: the RUNNER test queue lane, not an Operations clock
outside.rm-selftests-nightly: nightly selftests of finished mods (strategy §2 'Stay outside'), on a clean clone of origin/main (nightly_scope.py)
outside.rm-findings-judge: a role's job, not an Operations clock
outside.rm-store-ledger-diff: Relentless's nightly store/ledger reading: retired with Relentless 2026-11-13, unit masked
outside.rm-artisan-now: Artisan loops page: retired with the Artisan loops 2026-11-13, unit masked
outside.rm-whittle-now: Whittle loops page: retired with the Whittle loops 2026-11-13, unit masked
outside.rm-mirror: the D: mirror export, not an Operations clock
outside.rm-role-*: transient role runs (rm-role-<role>-<ts>: Conductor, Operations, ...), launched by systemd-run; ops_watch reads their result files
outside.rm-sheet-*: review-sheet servers an agent starts with systemd-run (src/RimMandrake/Utils/art/serve_gated.py): a page for the owner, not a clock
outside.rm-detached-*: transient detached helper runs (rm-detached-<seat>-<item>-<n>), launched by systemd-run from detached_helper.py: not a clock
